short: Partial local compatibility away from the coefficient prime

lean.name: UpperTheory.GalStar.AwayB
lean.plain: Partial local compatibility away from the coefficient prime
lean.note: The Galois and automorphic Weil–Deligne parameters have the same dimension at places away from $\ell$. A split character parameter with zero monodromy gives equality, while the stated tame square-free case over $\mathbb Q_p$ with zero monodromy gives agreement of the characteristic polynomials on inertia.
